distribution.narrative: Existing baseline occurrence from Liaoning and Heilongjiang is retained. Yang (2020) independently lists Liaoning; omission of Heilongjiang from this source does not remove earlier accepted evidence.

host_note: Existing baseline host evidence for Prunus armeniaca and Prunus padus is retained. Yang (2020) contributes distribution evidence only and supplies no host data.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Cryphalus malus Niisima, 1909.
